name: jsdelivr
description: jsDelivr is a free open-source CDN for npm and GitHub. This CLI searches npm packages, lists package versions, files, entrypoints and readmes, and reads CDN usage statistics (per package, version and file, top packages, network, countries, browsers, platforms and proxies) through jsDelivr's public data API and its Algolia search index.

commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Full-text search of npm packages hosted on jsDelivr (Algolia index), with optional facet filters such as module type, style type or author

params.name: query
params.description: Search keywords (URL-encode spaces and special characters, e.g. 'date%20picker')

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based result page

params.name: hitsPerPage
params.description: Results per page

params.name: filters
params.description: Optional Algolia filter expression, URL-encoded. Examples: 'moduleTypes%3Aesm' (ESM only), 'NOT%20styleTypes%3Anone' (CSS/style packages), 'owner.name%3Areact' (by author/owner). Leave empty for no fi

commands.name: get-npm-package-info
commands.summary: Get full npm metadata for a package from the search index: description, latest version, version release dates, npm downloads, jsDelivr hits, repo and owner

params.name: name
params.description: Exact npm package name

commands.name: list-package-versions
commands.summary: List all versions and dist-tags of an npm package or GitHub repo hosted on jsDelivr

params.name: type
params.description: Package source: npm or gh (GitHub)

params.name: name
params.description: npm package name, or 'user/repo' for GitHub

params.name: name

params.name: version
params.description: Exact version (from list-package-versions)

notes: No login is needed. All data comes from jsDelivr's public data API (data.jsdelivr.com/v1, OpenAPI spec at /v1/spec.yaml) and a public Algolia search key.
The 'name' param for gh packages is 'user/repo' (e.g. twbs/bootstrap). Scoped npm packages look like '@scope/pkg'. The slash must reach the server unencoded.
search-packages builds an Algolia 'params' query string, so query and filters values must be URL-encoded. The search page param is 0-based; the data.jsdelivr.com page params are 1-based.

Period values: day, week, month, quarter or year (rolling windows ending yesterday); s-month, s-quarter or s-year (last complete calendar period); or explicit periods such as 2026-09 or 2026-Q3 (see list-stats-periods). Browser and platform stats need s-* or explicit periods.
Stats responses include large per-day 'dates' maps. Use defaultFields totals unless you need the daily breakdown.

Workflow: search-packages → list-package-versions (get a version) → list-package-files / get-package-entrypoints / get-package-file-stats. The CDN file URL is https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/{type}/{name}@{version}/{file}.
